cohort: A convenience sample of 55 women with skeletal dysplasias and short stature who had 72 live births, recruited through Little People of America, Little People UK, Little People Canada, and the World Dwarf Games.
finding: The risk of preterm delivery in women with skeletal dysplasias and short stature is elevated compared to the general population, with a preterm birth rate of 26.4% (19/72 live births).
country: USA, UK, Canada (participants from these countries)
cross-section timing: Retrospective data collected via survey on past pregnancies and reproductive health.
gest_age: Delivery prior to 37 weeks was the primary measure for preterm birth.
